title: Compact Lusin set: a compact C ⊆ W ∩ E with c < μ(C) on which a Borel map u : ℝ^P → ℝ^N is continuous
statement: Let P, N ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, μ a measure on ℝ^P with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, and u : ℝ^P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) Borel. Let E ⊆ ℝ^P be Borel, W ⊆ U open and c ∈ [0, ∞] with c < μ(W ∩ E). Then there is a compact set C ⊆ W ∩ E with c < μ(C) such that u is continuous on C.
lean_statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (u : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → Measurable u → ∀ E : Set (Eucl P), MeasurableSet E → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, c < μ (W ∩ E) → ∃ C : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact C ∧ C ⊆ W ∩ E ∧ c < μ C ∧ ContinuousOn u C
